claim: Hôtel Régis & Jacques Marcon is 4-star Relais & Châteaux with 10 troglodyte rooms (9×50m², 1×95m²) on the same Larsiallas compound as the gastronomic restaurant, with a salt-treated pool reserved for guests.
quote: Une piscine (traitée au sel) est réservée aux clients. 9 chambres de 50m² et 1 suite de 95m². Larsiallas, 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.

claim: Les Maisons Marcon is a Relais & Châteaux member operating multiple lodging properties in Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid alongside the gastronomic restaurant.
quote: Les Maisons Marcon, luxury hotel Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid, Relais & Châteaux.

claim: The Marcon properties are split between three village streets: the 4-star hotel/restaurant at 18 chemin de Brard, Le Clos des Cimes and La Découverte at 2 chemin du Fanget, plus the bistrot and bar on rue du Vivarais.
quote: Restaurant & Hotel Marcon (4-star): 18 chemin de Brard. Hotels Le Clos des Cimes & La Découverte (3-star): 2 chemin du Fanget. Bistrot La Coulemelle: 3 rue du Vivarais. BP Bar de Païs: 1 rue du Vivarais.

claim: Le Clos des Cimes is a 3-star Marcon-operated stone house offering 30m² valley-view rooms and 38m² junior suites with spa access at Les Sources du Haut Plateau included (one access per person per night).
quote: Clos des Cimes Room: 30m² with valley view. Junior Suite: 38m². Access to the SPA is offered during your stay (one access per person per night).

claim: Hôtel La Découverte is a 3-star Marcon-operated property with 18m² rooms (double or twin), renovated in 2015, associated with Le Clos des Cimes and near the spa facility.
quote: Chambres de 18m² avec lit double ou twin. Rénové en 2015. Associé à notre maison Le Clos des Cimes.

claim: Tripadvisor's proximity list places Le Clos des Cimes-Découverte at 0.5 km (0.3 mi) from Hôtel Régis et Jacques Marcon, Chambres Chatelard and Les Bruyères de Gaschon at 0.6 km (0.4 mi), and Hob Fort du Pré at 1.0 km (0.6 mi).
quote: Le Clos des Cimes - Decouverte — 0.3 miles (0.5 km). Andre et Viviane Chatelard — 0.4 miles (0.6 km). Les Bruyeres De Gaschon — 0.4 miles (0.6 km). Hob Fort Du Pré — 0.6 miles (1.0 km).

claim: Hôtel Régis et Jacques Marcon rates 4.8/5 across 125 Tripadvisor reviews; guests repeatedly cite the no-distance walk to the 3-Michelin restaurant as the main draw and note rates of €350+ per night.
quote: Overall Rating: 4.8 of 5 bubbles (125 reviews). Guests note it's 'obligatory' when dining at the restaurant. €350+ per night mentioned in reviews.

claim: The Hôtel Marcon double room starts at €430 (taxes not included); breakfast is an extra €30 per person; reservations open on a 6-month rolling window.
quote: Chambre double à partir de 430€ HT. Petit-déjeuner: 30€/personne. Réservations ouvertes sur 6 mois glissants.

claim: Chambres Chatelard offers four suites in the village centre at 16bis rue du Vivarais with hammam included, from €130 per night (€165 with brunch + hammam); closed in January.
quote: Four suites. Address: 16bis, rue du Vivarais. Room only: €130. With brunch & hammam: €165. Closed in January.

claim: The Chatelard chambres d'hôtes are labelled Clévacances and described by the municipality as four spacious modern suites with hammam and tisanerie in the heart of the village.
quote: Quatre suites spacieuses et modernes avec hammam et tisanerie au cœur du village.

claim: Les Bruyères de Gaschon (101 chemin du Doux, lieu-dit Gaschon) offers unusual accommodations — Finnish barrel, gypsy caravan, Auvergne cabin — open early April to mid-November; a gîte is open April through December.
quote: Tonneau finlandais, roulotte, cabane auvergnate. Hébergements insolites: début avril à mi-novembre. Gîte: début avril à fin décembre.

claim: Les Bruyères de Gaschon is listed by the Haute-Loire tourism board as chambres d'hôtes/insolite at lieu-dit Gaschon, Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.
quote: Tonneau Finlandais - Les Bruyères de Gaschon à Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid - Chambres d'hôtes.

claim: Hob Fort du Pré, taken over by the Evi Hob brand in April 2022, runs 29 rooms with on-site restaurant, spa, pool, sauna, and fitness centre in Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.
quote: 29 comfortable rooms. Spa, swimming pool, sauna, fitness center. Reprise en avril 2022 par la marque Evi Hob.

claim: Hob Fort du Pré published rates run €95–186 by room category (standard €95–99 to family €162–186) with breakfast at €16; restaurant runs Tuesday evening to Sunday lunch March–December.
quote: Standard: €95–€99. Comfort: €135–€155. Family: €162–€186. Breakfast: €16. Open Tuesday evening to Sunday lunch.

claim: The Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid municipality lists exactly four hotel-category accommodations in the commune: Marcon (4★), Clos des Cimes/Découverte (3★), Hob Fort du Pré, and the Auberge des Myrtilles.
quote: Hôtellerie: Auberge des Myrtilles; Clos des Cimes-Découverte, Hôtels*** & Spa; Hob Fort du Pré; Marcon Restaurant Hôtel****.

claim: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid is a Haute-Loire village of about 280 inhabitants at 1,200 m altitude that has built its reputation around its restaurants, including the 3-Michelin-star Marcon.
quote: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid, petit village de 280 habitants à 1200 mètres d'altitude, est devenu une référence gastronomique.
